title: The Puppet Show Missing a Voice
youtube_title: The Puppet Show Missing a Voice | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Zev is just outside the fun, close to a puppet that had no voice yet. Isla changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Zev has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
